cases.title: Initiate drag event on product item
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true' and data-testid='product-item-1') initiates a drag event.

cases.title: Capture product title during drag event
cases.description: Verify that the drag event captures the product's title (identified by data-testid='product-title-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Capture product price during drag event
cases.description: Verify that the drag event captures the product's price (identified by data-testid='product-price-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Drag and drop product item into drop area updates cart display
cases.description: Verify that dragging and dropping a product item (e.g., data-testid="product-item-1") into the designated drop area (id="div1", data-testid="drop-area") updates the cart display such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Support adding both different and repeated products to the cart
cases.description: Verify that the system supports adding both different products and repeated products into the drop area, updating the cart display accordingly.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price formatted in allMoney
cases.description: Verify that the system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in目 the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays it in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

opinions.feedback: All requirements have been fully checked against the proposed test cases. Each explicit behavior (normal drag initiation, capturing title, capturing price, dropping into drop area, updating box1/box2/box3, supporting different and repeated products, and summing/formatting total price in allMoney) is properly matched to a distinct test case. There are no missing scenario gaps, no blockers, and no redundant or speculative cases.
All requirements have corresponding test cases mapped correctly without blockers or missing scenarios.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 has multiple distinct behaviors: initiating a drag event, capturing the product title, and capturing the product price. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 has multiple distinct behaviors: allowing drag and drop into the designated drop area, automatically updating the cart display (product title in .box2, unit price in .box3, quantity in .box1), and supporting both different and repeated products. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 has multiple distinct behaviors: summing the prices of all products in the cart, formatting the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol, and displaying the total in the <div id="allMoney"> element. No explicit boundary, edge, or abnormal error paths are mentioned in the text of any requirement, so only normal test scenarios are warranted based on the explicit statements.
